author: Alex Puncekar
description:
Robert Jackson Bennett’s follow-up to The Tainted Cup—A Drop of Corruption—continues with the same “what-if-Knives-Out-but-it’s-fantasy” formula as it’s previous, Hugo Award winning predecessor, and this new tale is all the more great because of it. When I wrote my review for The Tainted Cup, I mentioned that I just wanted more and more of these books. […]
